FULL DESIGN (deliverable) — stage=result. Design-only; no experiment run, no results invented.

========================================================================
0. DESIGN PRINCIPLES
========================================================================
• Head-to-head comparisons hold base model, prompts, seeds, and per-query attended-token budget (W + k·c + s) constant across ON and OFF arms, so differences are attributable to mechanism not compute.
• Staged to keep GPU-unknown: Phase 1 core crossover on minimal cells → Phase 2 unit-profile (one-factor-at-a-time at A=ON) → Phase 3 factorial on a small core subset. Full factorial run only if Phase 0 shows budget headroom.
• Retrieval-success (unit recall@k) is a first-class metric tier, splitting lookup quality from downstream reasoning.
• Placeholder defaults below (c≈128, k≈3, W≈1024, sink s≈4) are marked VERIFICATION PENDING (U1) — they must be confirmed from the paper/code before building anything.

Notation: W = sliding-window size, k = retrieved units, c = tokens/unit, s = attention-sink tokens. Default (pending) B: c=128, mean-pooled-key encoding, unit-level top-k selection, k=3.

========================================================================
1. CONDITIONS TABLE (full cell count)
========================================================================
FACTOR A — lookup mechanism (3 levels):
  A_ON        : dynamic unit-level lookup → top-k units' token KVs enter attention with sink+window.
  A_OFF_WIN   : active control — sink + window ONLY, window enlarged to W + k·c so per-query attended tokens match A_ON; no memory/lookup.
  A_OFF_STATIC: active control — sink + window (W) + fixed k·c tokens selected statically (variant a: first-N blocks; variant b: strided blocks), matched budget.
References (not factors): R1 full-context attention (oracle) capped at moderate length (default L_cap = 32K, fixed in Phase 0); R2 truncate-to-first-V-tokens (lower bound, V = W + k·c).

FACTOR B — unit representation:
  Bc granularity   : {64, 128, 256}
  Be encoding      : {mean-pooled keys (default), last-token key, learned/contrastive-refined (ONLY if the paper supports it — U2; else this level is dropped)}
  Bs selection     : {unit-level top-k (default), token-level routing}
  → full B grid = 3 × 3 × 2 = 18 (or 3×2×2 = 12 if learned encoding unsupported).

TASK SET (5 families):
  T1 NIAH (needle-in-haystack, staged) | T2 long-context multi-hop reasoning | T3 long-doc QA | T4 long-document summarization | T5 short-context counterparts of T1–T3 (length ≤ 4K, sanity baseline).

STAGE CELL COUNTS (unique treatment cells):
  Phase 1  core crossover: A{ON, OFF_WIN, OFF_STATIC} × B_default = 3 cells, run on all 5 families (+R1 at L_cap on T1–T3, R2 on all).
  Phase 2  unit-profile at A=ON: Bc{64,256} + Be_last-token (+Be_learned if supported) + Bs_token-routing = 4–5 unique cells, run on all 5 families.
  Phase 3  interaction subset (core tasks T1, T2, T3): A{ON, OFF_STATIC} × B_subset{mean/c128, mean/c256, last/c128, last/c256} → 8 cells; minus 5 already run in Ph1–2 ⇒ ~3 new cells; extends to A(3)×B_subset(4)=12 if budget allows.
  TOTAL: ≈ 11 core cells + (optional) up to 18-cell full B factorial on the core-task subset; each cell = (tasks × trials × seeds) repeated measures for CIs.

========================================================================
2. PER-TASK PROTOCOLS
========================================================================
Common: greedy decoding (temperature 0) OR seed-locked per instance across cells; identical prompt templates across all arms (no per-arm prompt tuning); ≥5 seeds per condition; report mean ± 95% CI.

T1 NIAH (staged): synthetic long documents with embedded needles.
  • Trial factors: needle depth d ∈ {0.05, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.95}; needle position ∈ {front, middle, back}; distractor count ∈ {0, 5, 20} needles; context length ∈ {8K, 32K, 128K} (longest only if Phase-0 GPU budget allows).
  • Metrics: needle-answer accuracy; UNIT_RECALL@k = did the unit containing the needle enter the top-k retrieved set?; depth×position error curves.

T2 Multi-hop: long-context reasoning with two evidence spans in distant units (separation controlled, e.g., ≥ 50% of context apart).
  • Metrics: final-answer EM; UNIT_RECALL@{k} over BOTH gold units.

T3 Long-doc QA: LongBench/LooGLE-style long-document QA with gold support passages.
  • Metrics: answer EM/F1; UNIT_RECALL@k w.r.t. the gold-support unit.

T4 Summarization: long-document summarization.
  • Metrics: faithfulness (NLI/FactScore-style) and ROUGE-L; UNIT_RECALL@k = coverage of manually-marked salient units (whether lookup selects informative units).

T5 Short counterparts (≤4K): same families at short length → sanity that the scaffolding (sink+window+our OFF/ON code paths) does not degrade short-context capability vs the base model; isolates "long-context burden".

========================================================================
3. METRICS AND ERROR TAXONOMY
========================================================================
Metric tiers:
  M1 primary: task accuracy (EM/F1/faithfulness) + UNIT_RECALL@k (retrieval-success as a matched, per-trial measurement).
  M2 efficiency (descriptive, to confirm budget match only): measured attended tokens/query, per-query wall-clock, KV memory — a check that the budget constraint holds, NOT a headline claim.
  M3 error attribution.

Error taxonomy (per failed trial, one label):
  E1 RETRIEVAL MISS   : correct unit not in top-k (unit recall@k fails) → failure attributable to lookup.
  E2 RETRIEVAL OK/REASON FAIL: unit retrieved, token attention saw it, downstream reasoning wrong.
  E3 LOCAL FAILURE    : required info inside the window and attended, yet wrong → base-model/capability limit.
  E4 SETUP FAILURE    : decode/format/parse errors (excluded from accuracy, reported separately).
Marginal-claim rule: E1 dominating the ON-vs-OFF gap ⇒ lookup critical; E2 dominating ⇒ unit coverage/representation critical; E3 dominating ⇒ the factor matters little (capability bottleneck). This is the experiment's core inference.

========================================================================
4. ANALYSIS PLAN
========================================================================
• Main effects: paired differences with CIs — (Δ ON vs OFF_WIN), (Δ ON vs OFF_STATIC) per task; (Δ unit variants) at A=ON.
• Interactions: two-way task × A (does lookup matter more on retrieval-heavy NIAH/QA than on summarization?); A × B in Phase 3 (does representation matter only when lookup is ON?).
• Retrieval-success mediation: plot accuracy vs UNIT_RECALL@k across cells; decompose the ON-vs-OFF gap into E1 vs E2 vs E3 shares.
• NIAH curve analysis: accuracy across depth × position × distractor; identify lookup-specific failure bands (deep/back needles, high distractors) vs uniform degradation.
• Robustness: Phase-2 profile (c, encoding, selection) reported as effect sizes with multiple-seed CIs, not only significance.

========================================================================
5. BUDGET MODEL (per query, matched across ON and OFF cells)
========================================================================
attended_tokens (per query, per layer):
  A_ON        : s + W + k·c          (lookup adds +m unit-representation scores, m = block count)
  A_OFF_WIN   : s + (W + k·c)        ← same total, enlarged window
  A_OFF_STATIC: s + W + k·c          ← same total, fixed blocks
  R1 (oracle) : L (capped at L_cap)  ← reference only
  R2 (trunc.) : V = W + k·c
Matching: the dominant attention term (QKᵀ + PV over attended tokens) is equal across A_ON/A_OFF_WIN/A_OFF_STATIC. A_ON adds only the cheap lookup over m compressed units (m ≪ m·c); Phase 0 MEASURES actual per-query FLOPs/wall-clock, and if the lookup term exceeds ~10% of per-query attention cost the matched-budget claim is weakened and reported as a caveat. KV memory is NOT matched across arms (inherent to the methods) — documented, kept out of the causal claim.

========================================================================
6. CONTROLS
========================================================================
C1 Budget + base-model match (Section 5). C2 Identical prompts/templates across all arms. C3 Multiple seeds + CIs; greedy/seed-locked decoding. C4 Oracle (R1, capped) and truncation (R2) envelope. C5 Short-context sanity (T5). C6 Static-block control covers both first-N and strided variants (resolves U3). C7 Lookup-quality confound excluded by measuring UNIT_RECALL@k separately from accuracy.

========================================================================
7. FEASIBILITY CHECKLIST
========================================================================
 [ ] Verify paper/code text for c, k, W, sink, unit encoding, and any contrastive refinement (A1/U1/U2) — FIRST action; update all "pending" placeholders before building.
 [ ] Confirm GPU availability & memory for cached per-unit KVs and retrieved-unit attention at target L (this environment has none — execution must move to a GPU cluster; Phase 0 calibrates).
 [ ] Confirm weights (Llama-2-7B) and datasets (synthetic NIAH generator, LongBench/LooGLE splits, summarization corpus) accessible.
 [ ] Phase 0: measure per-query FLOPs/wall-clock for A_ON vs A_OFF arms at one length; confirm budget match within tolerance; fix L_cap ≥ max{32K, feasible} for R1; fix max context length (8K/32K/128K) affordable.
 [ ] Smoke test: unit-encoding implementation reproduces paper defaults (mean-pooled keys) on a 5-instance run before staged execution.
 [ ] Decide learned-encoding level inclusion based on U2 outcome.
 [ ] Pre-register metrics, error taxonomy, and marginal-claim rules before Phase 1.

========================================================================
8. ASSUMPTIONS (verification pending) & UNCERTAINTIES
========================================================================
Carried from the approved sketch and now resolved: two OFF controls kept (U3 closed); retrieval-success as a primary metric tier; R1 capped at L_cap and short arms kept as sanity; c≈128 / mean-pool etc. remain verification-pending and wired to U1/U2. Full structured lists passed separately as fields: 7 assumptions and 6 uncertainties, the salient ones being — the paper/code is the source of truth and all placeholder hyperparameters/mechanism details are pending confirmation (A1/A2/U1); unit-representation encoding may be contrastively refined rather than pure mean-pooling (U2); GPU runtime at 8K/32K/128K is unverifiable here and Phase 0 calibrates it (U4); gold-span localization drives the QA/summ recall@k quality (U5).
